title: Resource Management in Heterogeneous Quantum Repeater Networks
summary: In this thesis, I explore whether it is possible to build a unified Quantum Internet architecture that supports different types of quantum repeaters -- especially the two most distinct and seemingly incompatible ones: memory-based quantum repeaters and all-photonic, memoryless repeaters. These technologies have traditionally been developed with the aim of becoming the single dominant solution, but I ask: Can they work together in the same network? What kind of architecture would support both? And how can simulation help us understand what is needed to manage such a network at scale? To…
